name: Bambuddy
description: Connects to printers managed by Bambuddy. Receives real-time AMS slot data via WebSocket and supports manual and automatic spool assignment.
author: FilaMan

sync_enabled.title: Inventar-Synchronisation
sync_enabled.description: Wenn aktiviert, werden FilaMan-Spulen automatisch ins Bambuddy-Inventar synchronisiert. Bei Deaktivierung nutzt Bambuddy die Spoolman API.

bambuddy_url.title: Bambuddy URL
bambuddy_url.description: Base URL of your Bambuddy instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8080

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Bambuddy API key (create in Bambuddy under Settings → API Keys)

printer_id.title: Bambuddy Printer ID
printer_id.description: Internal ID of the printer in Bambuddy

reconnect_interval_seconds.title: WebSocket Reconnect Interval (Seconds)
reconnect_interval_seconds.description: How long to wait before reconnecting after a WebSocket disconnect

sync_interval_seconds.title: Sync-Intervall (Sekunden)
sync_interval_seconds.description: Wie oft FilaMan-Spulen mit Bambuddy abgeglichen werden
